research_objective: Smoke test of Twin-2K-500 agent loading. Verify that a participant derived from the Twin-2K-500 dataset can be loaded and that the session runs to completion.
participant_collective_identity: US adults from the Twin-2K-500 panel
moderator_knowledge_brief: Brief warm-up conversation about daily routines. No specific research hypotheses.
researcher_notes: Smoke test — do not analyse. Single participant, single section, minimal turns.

participants.name: Participant_574
participants.profile_summary: Male, 18-29, living in the South (TX/LA/AL/FL/GA region). Some college, no degree. Student. Never married. Protestant, attends services once or twice a month. Republican, conservative. Household income $100,000 or more. Extraversion: moderate (3.5/5). Agreeableness: moderately high (4.1/5). Conscientiousness: moderate (4.0/5). Openness: moderate (3.6/5). Neuroticism: low (2.5/5). High agency (6.8/9), high communion (7.7/9). Low anxiety score. Note: full psychographic profile available in agents/twin2k500/twin_574.json.

discussion_guide.section_purpose: Get the participant talking about their daily routine. Establish comfort. This is a smoke test — keep it minimal.
discussion_guide.scripted_question: Can you give me a quick picture of what a typical weekday looks like for you — from morning until evening?
